wallpapers.title: Where the river tests the brave
wallpapers.caption: Migrating wildebeest crossing Mara River in Masai Mara, Kenya
wallpapers.desc: In the Masai Mara, Kenya, the ground seems to move. A vast surge of wildebeest—hoofed grazers built for endurance—travel in tightly packed herds, drawn by fresh grass and water replenished by seasonal rains.
wallpapers.bsTitle: Where the river tests the brave
